access.ssh_requirement: An authorized individual Nikhef account and custodian-granted read access. No shared credentials.

identity_policy: Physical locators do not redefine scientific content. Git history and release manifest hashes preserve the independent checksum record.

retention.analyzed: Retain accepted shards and PASS receipts for reconstruction and ancestry checks.
retention.deletion: The custodian must review information loss and preserve a verified retained copy before deletion of an active release dependency.
retention.guarantee: Custodian retention policy; no institution-wide archival service guarantee or indefinite storage allocation is claimed.
retention.merged: Retain original ROOT files, immutable inventories and GitHub release assets while results remain in use.
retention.query: Retain every complete workspace referenced by an active collection. Exact reduction needs its support rows.
retention.raw: Retain accepted raw files. Merged histograms omit raw information.
retention.relocation: Verify new copies against existing SHA-256 pins before publishing a replacement locator. Retain the previous inventory.
retention.replacement: Never overwrite an accepted file or an existing release asset with different bytes.
